title: 4521-ESP-AGE-58-70-0013 R0
summary:
- This document is an engineering specification for the supply of instruments for the Solana project.
- The specification includes definitions, scope of work, packaging requirements, and labeling/tagging instructions.
- Supplier responsibilities include delivering materials to designated locations and providing a single contact person for tracking material purchases.
- Confidentiality and alternate billing cycle notices are included in the document.
- Material must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
- Vendor data and approval drawings required.
- Monthly shipping of 2 units starting January 2012.
- Spare parts list with prices needed.
- Equipment to be inspected before shipment.
- Confidentiality agreement in place.
- Alternate billing cycle allowed.
